name: Popover
usage: Details of a person or a file on hover, a short form next to a button, filters

props.name: trigger
props.description:
What opens the card: `hover`, `focus` or `click`. Use `click` for content that can be operated (a form,
buttons), and `['hover', 'focus']` for details that keyboard users should see too.

props.name: placement
props.description: Position of the card relative to the trigger.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the card is open at first (uncontrolled).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the card opens or closes.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger: one element that accepts events and a ref.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
Opens on hover, and on keyboard focus with `trigger={['hover', 'focus']}`; focus is not moved. The trigger must
accept mouse and focus events, such as Button, LinkButton or IconButton (layout primitives such as Inline do not).

examples.name: Click
examples.title: Opened by click
examples.description: With `trigger="click"`, focus moves into the popover; `Esc` closes it and focus returns to the button.
